purpose: Every symbol a cook-cancel path on Houdini 22.0.368 would need, enumerated from the tree with a file:line anchor, so that an existence probe can return CONFIRMED / ABSENT / UNVERIFIABLE per symbol. Enumeration is static (VERIFIED-STATIC); the verdicts come from harness/notes/h3a_probe.py against the live build.

notes.gui_only: Symbols marked gui_only:true live under hou.ui, which does not exist in a headless hython session. A headless ABSENT for these is EXPECTED and is NOT evidence of absence on the build - only the live GUI session can answer them. This is the documented headless-symbol-table blind spot.
notes.candidate: Symbols marked candidate:true are NOT referenced anywhere in the tree. They are plausible names a cancel path would want. Probing them is how absence becomes a documented fact instead of an assumption - which is the entire point of this leg (R44).
